issues.problem: Both monitors face north, away from the chairs positioned south of their tables, so users would see the backs of the screens.
issues.fix: Rotate each monitor 180 degrees to face its associated chair.

issues.problem: The cabinet stands about 1 m away from the wall without a stated freestanding role and sits very close in front of part of shelf obj_0016, making that storage area awkward to access.
issues.fix: Move the cabinet against a suitable wall with its front facing into the room, keeping clear access to the shelf.
